notes: Fixes iPhone protected-record editing. Tapping Edit no longer fails when the live encrypted Vault iframe is not already loaded in memory. TEE now opens the encrypted editor automatically; if the encryption key was lost after an iPhone/PWA reload, the same edit panel asks for the Couple passphrase once and then opens the selected record automatically. No Maintenance, Source Documents, second search, or manual close/reopen sequence is required.
name: TEE v3.4.82 — Resilient One-Tap Vault Edit
